thread:
anna (Support): FYI Acme reporting big latency spikes and ~20% 502s since this morning. They say traffic should be served from us-east but traces show eu-west endpoints.
client-ops (Acme): yes — our logs show requests routed to eu-west-1 starting ~08:10 UTC. We didn't change anything on our side.
jordan (Eng): do you have a sample request we can inspect? headers + full url pls.
client-ops (Acme): sending an anonymized curl:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=eu -H "Authorization: Bearer XXXX" -H "X-Client-Id: acme-prod" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
client-ops (Acme): we also set X-Client-Region: us-east in our proxy but noticed the SDK started appending ?region=eu after an update.
lisa (SRE): aha — that looks like conflicting signals: query param region=eu vs header X-Client-Region: us-east. Our routing decision currently prefers explicit query params over headers for backwards compatibility. That explains why it went to eu.
anna (Support): can you paste the router log lines for one of the requests?
client-ops (Acme): pasted route log: `route_decision=param(region)=eu geoip=US -> route=eu-west-1 fallback_policy=regional` and our latency jumped from 80ms to 420ms.
jordan (Eng): thanks. Repro steps for us: 1) curl with only header -> routes to us-east 2) curl with only ?region=eu -> eu-west 3) curl with both -> currently routes to eu-west.
marco (Infra): quick mitigation: we can add a short-term rule to prefer X-Client-Region over query param for traffic from our US POPs. That would stop break until SDK fix. But need SRE + infra signoff.
lisa (SRE): +1. Also add detection metric for header/param conflicts so we can alert earlier.
jordan (Eng): we should also confirm whether the SDK change started shipping yesterday's build. @marco can you capture the SDK version from Acme headers?
client-ops (Acme): header `X-SDK-Version: 4.2.1-beta` — they rolled it out last night to a subset.
jordan (Eng): OK looks like a regression in SDK: it now auto-adds region param based on device locale; it shouldn't if user already sets header. I'll open an SDK PR to stop appending when X-Client-Region present.
anna (Support): action items: 1) SRE/Infra apply short-term rule to prefer header for us-east traffic (marco/lisa) 2) Eng patch SDK to not emit query param when header exists (jordan) 3) Support notify Acme and recommend temporary fix to pin SDK to 4.2.0 (anna) 4) add telemetry to detect param/header mismatch (lisa)
marco (Infra): creating infra change ticket and will roll a config in the us-east POPs in the next 15m.
deploy-bot: deploy started for infra-config/route-precedence at 1773801250
marco (Infra): rolled out, please verify.
client-ops (Acme): after your change requests are going to us-east again, latency back to ~95ms. thanks! :relieved: 
jordan (Eng): opened SDK PR and will release a hotfix. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1234
lisa (SRE): adding an alert rule and a Grafana panel for conflicting-region-signals.
anna (Support): closing loop with Acme and scheduling a follow-up postmortem doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
